title: Early Car Loan Payoff Power

scenes.text: How a $1,200 car loan costs $10,000 total
$1,200 monthly payment on a 5‑year loan at 4% interest totals roughly $72,000 paid.
Paying an extra $200 each month cuts interest, saving about $8,000 over the loan term.

scenes.text: Surprise: making one extra payment each year halves the total interest.
